pages.text: PRINT writes a value on the screens and starts a new line.

An expression follows and ends with $(1);$(). The text appears on every display, laptop and tablet that is bound to the program and function. Strings are printed without quotes, BOOLEAN values as $(1)TRUE$() and $(1)FALSE$(). Arrays, hashes and structs are printed as JSON.
To print several values on one line, join them with ⊕. Without a bound screen, PRINT does nothing.
